<center><h1><font size="6"> Anna Malinovskaya</h1></font> </center>
<br>
<center>
<font size="4"> I am a Postdoctoral Research Associate at Yale University's <a href="https://tobin.yale.edu/" style="color: #8B0000; text-decoration: underline;">Tobin Center for Economic Policy</a> in the Economics Department. Prior to joining Yale, I was a Postdoctoral Fellow at Princeton University's <a href="https://chw.princeton.edu/" style="color: #8B0000; text-decoration: underline;">Center for Health and Wellbeing</a>. At both institutions, I have been advised by Professor <a href="https://economics.yale.edu/people/janet-currie" style="color: #8B0000; text-decoration: underline;">Janet Currie</a>. I hold a Ph.D. in <a href="https://dyson.cornell.edu/" style="color: #8B0000; text-decoration: underline;">Applied Economics & Management</a> from Cornell University. My fields of specialization are Public Economics and Applied Microeconomics, with interests in Health and Labor. </font>
